Ran 42 commands, read memory, and 2 more tools
Phase 16 is in positional-phase16.tar.gz. It holds 23 files: 21 modified and 2 new (viewmodels/viewmodel/PanelSettings.kt and PanelSettingsTest.kt). Extract it at the repository root. Nothing needs deleting, so there is no git rm this time.

I only syntax-checked the code here. The real compile and the tests run in CI.

What changed:

Settings as flows:
A new SharedPreferences.watch(keys) { read } re-reads a setting when one of its keys changes, and only passes on values that actually differ.
A new preference(...) helper turns that into a StateFlow on a view model.
The compass, clock, direction, GPS, trail, measure and level view models now expose their settings this way.
Panels: they apply settings with a new PanelController.bind, which applies the current value at once and then follows changes while the panel is started. PanelController and WrappedViewModel no longer register preference listeners.
Other listeners converted: the clock’s time zone and custom location, the location provider, the GPS target, and the selected trail and measure now follow preferences through flows.
Trail switching: switching trails now redraws the map from the trail’s points, so TrailMap.clear() was removed.
Settings panel: it no longer recreates the activity on an accent change. The accent screen already does that, so it was happening twice.
Tests: a new PanelSettingsTest covers map rotation priority, the compass bloom when off or unknown, and the needle and pin fallbacks.
README: phase 16 is marked done, and phase 17 is listed as next: the map views’ own preference listeners become flows.
Worth checking on the Nord:

Switch trails from the trails list. The map should show the new trail on return, with no leftover lines from the old one.
Change the compass bloom and physics settings, the clock needles and motion type, the GPS pin and rotation, and the tools side on each map panel. Each should apply immediately.
Pick an accent colour. The app should recreate once.
Please re-run export.sh and upload the new dump before phase 17.
